description: Player 1's deck for spec 08 at R389's 60-turn cap: 08-do-nothing-a with #100 Ceaseless Void swapped for #75 Infinite Reserves, a (0) Field Spell ("Drawing from an empty deck gives you a Rush Token card instead of fatigue."). Since patch v0.2.0 doubled the cap, two do-nothing 20-card decks fatigue out at player-turn 48 (R389's engine test), so each seat now holds Infinite Reserves and plays it, the only card the spec plays. Everything else is 08-do-nothing-a's reasoning: no Cast-on-draw, no Quickdraw, no hand trigger, no X-cost or embiggen card, every other cost 3 or more, so nothing resolves by itself and no hero loses health. The spec's seed (08-turn-cap-26) deals Infinite Reserves into this seat's opening hand.
